entities.summary: Baba Harbhajan Singh (1946–1968) was an Indian Army soldier who served from 30 June 1965 to 4 October 1968. He is said to serve the Indian Army even after his death by coming in dreams of soldiers and telling them the plans of their enemies. There is a temple dedicated to him in East Sikkim. Baba Harbhajan Singh was a military leaders & commanders (1946-08-30–1968-10-04). Relevant to geopolitics.
